cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" OCHRE = "#D4A72C" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786" LIGHT = "#DCE4E7"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.color": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "lines.linewidth": 1.6, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.9), dpi=100) fig.text( 0.035, 0.943, "Cooley–Tukey FFT: the butterfly operation", fontsize=17, weight="semibold", ha="left" ) fig.text( 0.035, 0.883, r"$N=4$ illustration • One half-turn gives two outputs from the same twiddle product", fontsize=10.5, color=SLATE, ha="left" )
fig.text(0.035, 0.785, "a Half-turn sign flip", fontsize=11.5, weight="semibold") fig.text(0.335, 0.785, "b Butterfly operation", fontsize=11.5, weight="semibold") fig.text(0.755, 0.785, "c Complexity recurrence", fontsize=11.5, weight="semibold")
fig.text( 0.035, 0.729, r"$\omega_N^{-(k+N/2)}=-\omega_N^{-k}$", fontsize=12 ) fig.text( 0.335, 0.729, r"Single $k=0,\ldots,N/2-1$; for $N=4$: $k=0,1$", fontsize=9, color=SLATE )
# Panel a: an actual N=4 root and its antipode, with k=0 stated explicitly. ax_circle = fig.add_axes([0.039, 0.263, 0.250, 0.419]) ax_circle.set_aspect("equal") ax_circle.set_xlim(-1.48, 1.48) ax_circle.set_ylim(-1.23, 1.20) ax_circle.axis("off") ax_circle.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=SLATE, linewidth=1.3)) ax_circle.annotate( "", xy=(1.40, 0), xytext=(-1.36, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8, color=LIGHT) ) ax_circle.annotate( "", xy=(0, 1.17), xytext=(0, -1.15), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8, color=LIGHT) ) ax_circle.plot([-1, 1], [0, 0], color=SLATE, lw=1.1, ls=(0, (3, 3))) ax_circle.plot(0, 0, "o", color=INK, ms=3) ax_circle.plot(1, 0, "o", color=BLUE, ms=7) ax_circle.plot(-1, 0, "s", color=TEAL, ms=6) ax_circle.text(0.98, 0.22, r"$\omega_4^{0}$", color=BLUE, ha="center", fontsize=11) ax_circle.text(-0.98, 0.22, r"$\omega_4^{-2}$", color=TEAL, ha="center", fontsize=11) ax_circle.text(1, -0.28, r"$+1$", ha="center", fontsize=9, color=BLUE) ax_circle.text(-1, -0.28, r"$-1$", ha="center", fontsize=9, color=TEAL) ax_circle.text(0.09, -0.25, "0", fontsize=8, color=SLATE) ax_circle.text(1.35, -0.19, "Re", fontsize=8, color=SLATE, ha="center") ax_circle.text(0.09, 1.08, "Im", fontsize=8, color=SLATE) ax_circle.text(0, 0.55, r"$180^\circ$", ha="center", fontsize=10, color=SLATE)
fig.text(0.163, 0.230, r"Unit circle; $N=4,\ k=0$ shown", ha="center", fontsize=9, color=SLATE) fig.text(0.035, 0.158, r"$\omega_4^{-(k+2)}=\omega_4^{-k}\,\omega_4^{-2}$", fontsize=10.5) fig.text(0.035, 0.104, r"$\omega_4^{-2}=-1\quad\Rightarrow\quad-\omega_4^{-k}$", fontsize=10.5)
# Panel b: split E and the once-computed twiddle product P into two sums. ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.331, 0.285, 0.398, 0.385]) ax_b.set_xlim(0, 1) ax_b.set_ylim(0, 1) ax_b.axis("off")
top, bottom = 0.78, 0.23 source, split, merge, out = 0.07, 0.39, 0.79, 0.96
def arrow(x0, y0, x1, y1, color, lw=1.6): ax_b.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=8, linewidth=lw, color=color, shrinkA=2, shrinkB=3, zorder=2 ))
# Input E travels directly to the upper split. ax_b.plot([source, split], [top, top], color=BLUE, lw=1.6) ax_b.plot(source, top, "o", color=BLUE, ms=5) ax_b.text(source, top + 0.115, r"$E_k$", color=BLUE, ha="center", fontsize=12)
# O is multiplied before its product splits. mult_x = 0.245 arrow(source, bottom, mult_x - 0.035, bottom, TEAL) ax_b.plot(source, bottom, "s", color=TEAL, ms=5) ax_b.text(source, bottom - 0.15, r"$O_k$", color=TEAL, ha="center", fontsize=12) ax_b.scatter([mult_x], [bottom], s=225, facecolor="white", edgecolor=OCHRE, linewidth=1.8, zorder=4) ax_b.text(mult_x, bottom, r"$\times$", color=OCHRE, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, zorder=5) ax_b.text(mult_x, bottom + 0.15, r"$\omega_N^{-k}$", color=OCHRE, ha="center", fontsize=12) ax_b.plot([mult_x + 0.034, split], [bottom, bottom], color=TEAL, lw=1.6) ax_b.text(split + 0.015, bottom - 0.15, r"$P_k$", color=TEAL, ha="center", fontsize=11)
# No node is placed at the crossing: the two branches do not mix there. arrow(split, top, merge, top, BLUE) arrow(split, top, merge, bottom, BLUE) arrow(split, bottom, merge, top, TEAL) arrow(split, bottom, merge, bottom, TEAL) ax_b.plot(split, top, "o", color=BLUE, ms=4) ax_b.plot(split, bottom, "o", color=TEAL, ms=4)
for yy in (top, bottom): ax_b.scatter([merge], [yy], s=150, facecolor="white", edgecolor=INK, linewidth=1.2, zorder=5) ax_b.text(merge, yy, "+", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, zorder=6) arrow(merge + 0.025, yy, out, yy, INK, lw=1.3)
label_box = dict(facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", pad=0.5) ax_b.text(0.66, top + 0.065, r"$+1$", color=BLUE, fontsize=9, bbox=label_box) ax_b.text(0.67, top - 0.165, r"$+1$", color=TEAL, fontsize=9, bbox=label_box) ax_b.text(0.67, bottom + 0.13, r"$+1$", color=BLUE, fontsize=9, bbox=label_box) ax_b.text(0.66, bottom - 0.135, r"$-1$", color=TEAL, fontsize=9, bbox=label_box) ax_b.text(out - 0.015, top + 0.115, r"$X_k$", ha="center", fontsize=11) ax_b.text(out - 0.015, bottom - 0.16, r"$X_{k+N/2}$", ha="center", fontsize=10)
fig.text(0.335, 0.229, r"$P_k=\omega_N^{-k}O_k$", fontsize=10, color=TEAL) fig.text(0.335, 0.158, r"$X_k=E_k+\omega_N^{-k}O_k$", fontsize=11) fig.text(0.335, 0.104, r"$X_{k+N/2}=E_k-\omega_N^{-k}O_k$", fontsize=11)
# Panel c: supplied recurrence and leading-order work comparison. fig.text(0.755, 0.689, r"$T(N)=2T(N/2)+N/2$", fontsize=12) fig.text(0.755, 0.624, r"$\phantom{T(N)}=O(N\log_2 N)$", fontsize=12, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.755, 0.531, r"For $N=65\,536$", fontsize=10.5, weight="medium") fig.text(0.755, 0.455, "Direct DFT", fontsize=9, color=SLATE) fig.text(0.755, 0.401, r"$N^2=4.29\times10^9$ ops", fontsize=11) fig.text(0.755, 0.326, "FFT", fontsize=9, color=SLATE) fig.text(0.755, 0.272, r"$N\log_2 N=1.05\times10^6$ ops", fontsize=10.4, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.755, 0.166, r"$4096\times$ speedup", fontsize=15, color=BLUE, weight="semibold") fig.text(0.755, 0.108, "Leading-order work ratio", fontsize=8.5, color=SLATE)
fig.text( 0.035, 0.028, r"$\omega_N=e^{2\pi i/N}$ • Recurrence counts twiddle multiplications; operation comparisons use leading-order scaling.", fontsize=8.2, color=SLATE, ha="left" )
